class.name: HEGoNode3D
class.brief_description: Brings a Houdini Digital Asset into a Godot scene.
class.description: Pick an HDA with [b]Select HDA[/b], set its parameters in the HEGo bottom panel, and recook. Cooking instantiates the HDA in the running Houdini session, feeds it the nodes wired up as inputs, cooks it, and turns the result into Godot nodes under a child called [code]Outputs[/code]. This node handles the great majority of cases. When you want one that does something it does not - its own attributes, its own output nodes, several HDAs chained together - write your own and use [HEGoAssetAgent], which is what this node uses. Read [method cook] below first: it is the worked example, and there is nothing in it a script of your own cannot do.

method.name: cook
method.description: Instantiates the HDA if needed, pushes inputs and parameters, cooks it and rebuilds the [code]Outputs[/code] subtree from the result. Children that extend [HEGoCookExtension] take part at each step; see [method cook_extensions]. Without any, this is the whole of a cook.

method.name: output_handlers
method.description: The output handlers a cook runs, in the order it runs them: HEGo's mesh, multimesh and object output, then every [HEGoOutputHandler] other addons provide (see [method HEGoOutputHandler.extension_handlers]), then curve output. Each has [code]output_phase()[/code], [code]should_handle(summary)[/code] and [code]handle(context)[/code]: HEGo's own are scripts with those as static functions, the extension handlers are instances. Override this in a subclass to add one of your own, to drop one this node does not need, or to change the order. A function rather than a constant, because GDScript cannot build a constant out of other classes' references, and because the extension handlers are discovered at run time.

method.name: cook_extensions
method.description: The children that take part in this node's cooks, in child order: every direct child that extends [HEGoCookExtension]. This is how another addon adds to what a cook does without HEGo knowing about it, for example by checking or publishing the cook's result before the [code]Outputs[/code] subtree is replaced.

method.name: hego_use_bottom_panel
method.description: Tells the plugin this node can be edited from the HEGo bottom panel.

method.name: hego_did_last_cook_succeed
method.description: Whether the last cook ran to the end. The panel only reads parameters back after one that did, so a failed cook cannot overwrite the stash with a half-restored asset.

method.name: hego_notify_cook_inputs_changed
method.description: Tells this node's cook extensions that its inputs or parameters changed, and emits [signal cook_inputs_changed]. The panel calls it on every edit, and [method hego_set_input_stash] calls it too.

method.name: hego_requires_explicit_cook
method.description: Whether recooking should wait for an explicit request rather than following every edit, because one of this node's cook extensions, or the input handler of one of its input rows (see [method HEGoInputHandler.requires_explicit_cook]), asks for that. The panel's auto recook is skipped while this is true.

method.name: hego_get_asset_node
method.description: The asset node the bottom panel reads parameters from, or null before the first cook.

method.name: hego_set_parm_stash
method.description: Stores a parameter preset so it survives session restarts and scene reloads.

method.name: hego_set_input_stash
method.description: Stores the input references the bottom panel collected. Each HDA input can combine several Godot nodes, so [param input_array] holds one entry per HDA input, each with its own list of node paths and its settings.

method.name: hego_set_asset_name
method.description: Lets the panel's asset picker change which HDA this node cooks. Implementing this is what tells the panel the picker applies at all; a node with an HDA written into its script leaves it out and gets no picker button.

members.member: Opens the HDA picker. The chosen operator is written to [member asset_name].
The asset definition name in Houdini, e.g. Sop/my_tool
The HDA's parameters as a blob, so they survive a session restart and a scene reload.
References to the Godot nodes wired into the HDA's inputs, one entry per input.
The tedious parts of driving an HDA. Everything it does is an ordinary call on [HEGoAssetNode]; see [HEGoAssetAgent].

signal.name: cook_inputs_changed
signal.description: Emitted by [method hego_notify_cook_inputs_changed]: this node's inputs or parameters changed since its last cook, so anything built from that cook may be out of date. Lets another addon react at once without HEGo knowing about it; the HEGo Strata bridge, for example, marks the terrain layers this node published as stale.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
